newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen bank shares steady despite probe.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen bank shares steady despite probe.

text.p: The domestic currency A shares of Shenzhen Development Bank Co were down only slightly in late afternoon on Monday despite the bank's announcement it might have been involved in stock trading irregularities.

The bank's large-capitalisation A shares -- which resumed trading in the afternoon after being suspended in the morning for the announcement -- were trading at 36.90 yuan, down 0.24 yuan, on volume of 24.6 million shares just before the market closed.
"The price has not plunged because the dividend plan remained intact," a broker at China Guotai Securities said.

The bank said it was investigating possible stock trading irregularities in 1996, plans to make a five-for-10 bonus share issue and 0.2 yuan per share cash dividend based on 1996 profits were unchanged.
Company officials confirmed a probe was taking place but declined to give details.
